name: Gamma
summary: Create presentations, documents and websites with AI.
description: Gamma generates presentations, documents, websites and social posts from a prompt, outline or imported file, with editable designs and online sharing. It is known for replacing slide design work with fluid web-native cards. The Free plan gives 400 one-time credits and up to 10 slides per prompt; Plus is $9/seat/month billed annually ($12 monthly) and Pro $18/month billed annually.
